findings.finding: α∈ℱ⇔A(x)=∑α(i)x^i, deg≤8. Need A·B=x^k+x^l ⇒ A|x^e(1+x^d). Over ℤ[x], 1+x^d=∏_{r∈R(d)}Φ_r, r even. Thus A=±x^e·∏_{r∈S}Φ_r with all r having same v₂. φ(r)≤8, sum≤8. Enumerate r≤30: (2,1),(4,2),(6,2),(8,4),(10,4),(12,4),(14,6),(16,8),(18,6),(20,8),(24,8),(30,8). Subsets with equal v₂ and Σφ≤8: 22 sets. For each, e can be 0…8−Σφ ⇒ 9−Σφ choices. Σ(9−Σφ)=80. Include ± sign ⇒ 2·80=160 shifty α. Pitfall: must enforce same v₂; otherwise overcount.
